caption: The drawing features three views of a blue dress, displayed on a plain beige background. The main, largest view shows the front of the dress, which has long, full sleeves gathered at the cuffs, a fitted bodice with a slight v-neck and buttons down the front, and a wide, floor-length skirt with a subtle striped or marbled pattern in varying shades of blue. White lace or fabric is visible at the sleeve cuffs. To the right of the main view, there are two smaller views: one from the back and one in profile. The back view shows the same wide skirt, gathered at the waist, and the profile view includes a matching blue bonnet that covers the head and a portion of the shoulders, with the dress skirt flaring outward. Both smaller views also display the same blue color and striped effect, along with the white lace cuffs. The dresses are depicted with careful shading to emphasize the fabric's texture and folds. No human figures are present; the garments are illustrated as empty forms.
title: Dress
